note: Cut from main after #342 and #343, plus the Inter/Chivo Mono type, the opt-in query sharing and the NLI evidence gate. The Windows installer, portable ZIP and engine ZIP were built on a Windows host with kriko-ui/package.ps1 from a clean worktree of this source; the build's own checks passed (frozen engine handshake and a served request, the app staying up 25 s with its engine spawned, the portable ZIP). The installer was not installed and no journey below was walked on a packaged window, so release_readiness.py still refuses complete stable certification, as for 0.3.10-0.3.12. No macOS build was made.

fresh_install.evidence: The installer was built (kriko-0.3.13-x86_64-setup.exe) but not installed: the install check writes per-user entries and refuses where a Kriko is already installed.

portable_start.evidence: The build's own start-up check opened the staged kriko.exe, which stayed up for 25 s and spawned its engine; the unzipped portable archive was not separately walked.

setup.evidence: Not walked on a packaged window.

sourced_answer.evidence: No live research on a packaged engine; the #343 refactor is covered by the full suite (5167 passed) incl. the 210 chat tests driving run_turn.

mistral-vibe.report: src/app/tests/test_a_cut_off_resident_turn_keeps_its_answer.py: resident-timeout health marking (#341) and cut-off text keeping, unchanged by #343

observed_instead: Python on the final tree: ruff clean; mypy clean (src/kriko 40 files, src/app 272, packs 53); the whole src and packs suite ran with xdist and ended with 17 failures, none from this release: 15 fail identically on a clean origin/main (the network-dependent agent bench and failure-class tests, and a version test that reads stale installed metadata) and 2 are load flakes that pass when run alone. kriko-ui: oxlint exit 0, vite build ok, 123/123 node tests.

kriko-ui/package.ps1 -Version 0.3.13 from a clean git worktree of this source built kriko-0.3.13-x86_64-setup.exe, kriko-0.3.13-win64-portable.zip and kriko-engine-0.3.13-win64.zip, with the sidecar handshake, the app start-up check and the portable zip checks passing. The sidecar's smoke test fails when run from inside the repository folder in the build sandbox used here (a sandbox rule on executables in that tree: the identical engine runs when copied elsewhere, and the 0.3.11 engine runs); it passes from a worktree outside it.
